arguments.code:
access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2dsZW5uLmJ1cnRvbkBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODQ0MTIwOTh9.ZfYQhLH5HAUhTGeoP9Sil5Smkby8zvIfSpm2gzMvmWk'
page_limit=20
songs=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    # resp is expected to be a list
    print('page',page_index,'items',len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    songs.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1
print('total_songs',len(songs))
print('first_song_sample',songs[0] if songs else None)
print('last_song_sample',songs[-1] if songs else None)

# compute least-played song title from Spotify song library
try:
    library_songs = songs
except NameError:
    library_songs=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        library_songs.extend(resp)
        page_index+=1

print('library_count',len(library_songs))

song_stats=[]
for idx,s in enumerate(library_songs):
    sid=s['song_id']
    detail=apis.spotify.show_song(sid)
    # show_song doesn't require token per spec
    play_count=detail.get('play_count', None)
    title=detail.get('title', s.get('title'))
    song_stats.append({'song_id':sid,'title':title,'play_count':play_count,'added_at':s.get('added_at')})

# find least played
min_play=min(st['play_count'] for st in song_stats)
least=[st for st in song_stats if st['play_count']==min_play]
print('min_play',min_play,'tie_count',len(least))
# deterministic tiebreak: lowest song_id, then title
least_sorted=sorted(least, key=lambda x:(x['song_id'], x['title']))
selected=least_sorted[0]
print('selected',selected)
print('all_least_titles',[x['title'] for x in least_sorted])
selected_title=selected['title']
selected_title
